utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Don't forget to bring any broken small appliances—I've got a soft spot for fixing toasters and lamps.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Toasters! Right, I think I've got a toaster that's been acting up... or was it a coffee maker? Let me go check my garage—might find that note too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Take your time, Oren! If it's the coffee maker, I've got a trick for descaling those things too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Well, I think I've got it now — Bob's garage for broken electronics. Maybe I'll finally bring that busted lamp over later.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, Bob's garage? I thought it was at the community center or something.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, shoot — are you sure? I could've sworn Mrs. Gable said Bob's garage, but maybe I mixed it up again.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, are you planning to bring your own tools to the repair drive, or should I bring extra?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I've got a good set of tools, but extra hands are always welcome. If you have a favorite screwdriver, bring it along—just in case.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I'll bring a few extra screwdrivers just in case. And do you know if we need any specific materials like wood or metal?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about that repair drive? I haven't seen any official notice about it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, it's definitely happening! Mr. Henderson's fence is falling apart, and I've already got Gus, Opal, and Faye on board.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, Mr. Henderson himself told you that? I just saw him yesterday and he didn't say a word about it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Morning. I brought my tools.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, Uli! Gus is already on the wobbly step, so your tools will come in handy for other fixes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good, I'll start on that loose shutter at the corner then. Should be quick.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Pia, how's the drive looking? I've got my list of file sizes ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Eli, you'll be thrilled to hear the Smiths are bringing their old lawnmower, and Jerry's convinced that drive can fix anything—even if he once thought his car could fly!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, that's all well and good, but let's not get sidetracked. Pia, what's the drive's capacity?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Faye, glad you're here—I wanted to ask if you can help with the repair drive this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, Rey! I've already been lining things up. What do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks Faye. Could you help me sort through the donated tools and make sure everything's labeled before Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh shoot, I think I got things mixed up — the repair drive is actually at Mr. Henderson's place, not the community center. Sorry about that, Dane!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries, Opal. So it's at Henderson's place? I'll bring my busted toaster there Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, that's right! I'm glad you're still coming, Dane. I heard they're going to have a few workstations set up in his garage.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I've got the drive here. Eli, how are those file sizes looking?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, Pia, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center? We're fixing up old appliances—Noah's already bringing his toaster!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, Vik, I'm trying to focus on the backup drive space right now—can we circle back to that repair drive plan in a minute?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Cleo, I just got word—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday. Hope that still works for you!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, thanks for the heads up, Rosa! Sunday works fine for me—I'll still bring those spare parts I mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I'm so relieved Sunday works for you! Your spare parts will be a real lifesaver.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Noah, I've been gathering details about the repair drive. Do you know if anyone's mentioned needing special parts for electronics, like new switches or wiring?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive! Sorry, I keep zoning out—I've been meaning to ask if they can help with my leaky faucet, but I haven't thought about electronics parts.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries at all! I can ask around about the faucet—do you know what kind of fixture it is?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Leo, you should see the pile growing at Bob's garage—old fans, lamps, you name it. Want me to check if they need anything from the store while I'm out?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'm good, thanks. Just need extra extension cords if you spot any.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Leo, I'll keep an eye out for those extension cords—you can never have enough, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Hana, I've already got the tools and boxes lined up. Just let me know if you need me to help sort or load anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? Oh right, is that today? I thought it was next week... did I miss something?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No, Oren, it's still this weekend. Saturday morning, actually. Want me to swing by and help you gather any tools or items you'd like to contribute?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, the repair drive's really taking off—need me to grab anything from the hardware store while I'm out?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about that repair drive? I haven't heard any official confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, it's definitely happening — I saw the flyers up at Bob's garage myself. Want me to grab you a flyer while I'm out?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Alright, I've got the drive here—let me plug it in and see how much free space we're working with.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, let me know what you find—I can start sorting through my spare parts pile while you check the digital stuff.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, the drive shows about 500GB free. How's that list of file sizes coming along?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, the repair drive! It's this Saturday at the community center, starting at 9 AM. They're fixing broken household items for free.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, Saturday at 9. I've got a toaster that's been acting up—I'll bring it along.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Bo! I bet they'll get that toaster working in no time. I'll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, sounds like we've got good participation. See you both at the fence.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Wait, Leo—the repair drive is at 10 AM at the community center, not the fence. That's a different thing!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Right, thanks Vik. I'll be at the community center at 10.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Eli! Are you planning to join the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up Mr. Henderson's fence and could use all the help we can get!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure thing, Quinn! I'll be there. Let's make sure we have a list of tools and materials ready before Saturday—keeps everything orderly.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great idea! I'll start a shared list and send it around—let's make sure everyone's on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, just checking in—are you all set for the repair drive on Saturday? I've got Gus bringing his toolbox, so we should be covered on that end.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I think so. Sam mentioned we'll need sturdy boxes and some blankets for wrapping fragile items—do you have those ready?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great point, Hana — I can grab some blankets and boxes from my garage. Let's make a list so we don't forget anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, are you planning to bring your own tools to the repair drive, or should I bring extra?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Tools? Oh right, the repair drive! I, uh, haven't thought that far ahead yet—I'm still trying to remember where I put my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, how about I bring a basic set, and you can check your garage later?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Tess, hope I'm not too late—what's the deal with this repair drive? I've got a toaster that's been on the fritz.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Dane, you're right on time! The drive starts at 9, and we've got folks bringing all sorts—even Jerry's bringing his old lawnmower, bless his heart. Your toaster will be in good hands!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I'll drag it over Saturday morning. Anyone got a knack for rewiring, or should I bring extra patience too?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Rosa, just a heads-up—the repair drive is at 10 AM at the community center, but I'm heading to Elm Street at 9 to fix the fence first. Want to join me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I'd love to help with the fence, but I've got to set up the tables for the repair drive. See you at the center at 10!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Rosa! I'll see you at the center after the fence is done.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, I've got the truck all packed with tools for Saturday. Need me to help set up the workstations?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Gus, thanks for asking! I think Bob's garage is the spot—Ira told me that's where we're fixing things with cords. I'm still a little fuzzy on the details, but I'd love to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Nell. I'll swing by Bob's garage Saturday morning and we can get those workstations set up together.
